best_policy_rule: BEST_STRUCTURAL_POLICY = highest mean paired delta vs C0_2R with >= 100 pairs; descriptive only; partial fraction never promoted

decision_rules.A: FIXED_TARGET_MODEL_INFERIOR: C1 or a runner family (all fractions, R0) beats every C0_k pairwise (mean delta > 0, >= 100 pairs)
decision_rules.C: NATURAL_TARGET_PLUS_RUNNER_SUPPORTED: some runner family R0 beats every C0_k AND C1 across ALL fractions
decision_rules.D: RUNNER_CONTINUATION_TOO_WEAK: P(2nd|1st) < 0.35 OR no runner policy beats C1 on any fraction
decision_rules.E: TARGET_POLICY_DEPENDS_ON_SL_GEOMETRY: every pooled positive paired advantage is confined to risk quartiles Q1/Q2
decision_rules.F: T1_DIRECTION_FILTER_HARMS_RUNNER_CONTINUATION: D01 P(2nd|1st) exceeds T1's by >= 5pp (evaluated for T1)
decision_rules.G: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: population or pair floors unmet
decision_rules.freeze_rule: if D01 primary is C -> freeze the qualifying runner family contract (fraction grid intact, no selection); if B -> freeze C1 contract; else NO_FREEZE; frozen contract is hashed for a FUTURE OOS mission only

economics_gate: realized economics ONLY if EXIT_CONTRACT_COMPLETE and FRICTION_AUTHORITY_COMPLETE; both fail closed here
fraction_grid_rule: 25/75, 50/50, 75/25 sensitivity grid only; no best percentage may be promoted from DEV
objective: does a causal natural-target (+ runner) exit policy improve structural target delivery vs the frozen fixed-R ladder on the SAME entries? DEVELOPMENT research only; no promotion
pathwise_rule: all policy comparisons are paired on the SAME entry ids, both outcomes resolved; different-population exit inference is forbidden

policy_contracts.C1: exit 100% at FIRST_VALID_CAUSAL_OBJECTIVE (V0.5 primary rule); NOT_APPLICABLE when no causal objective exists at entry
policy_contracts.C2: partial f% at FIRST objective + runner (100-f)% to SECOND objective; NOT_APPLICABLE when no second objective exists
policy_contracts.C3: partial f% at FIRST objective + runner to FURTHEST objective; NOT_APPLICABLE when the ladder has a single objective
policy_contracts.C4: partial f% at FIRST objective + runner to the frozen fixed 5R ceiling; NOT_APPLICABLE when FIRST objective R >= 5
policy_contracts.R0: runner retains the original frozen SL (full -1R on the runner fraction if stopped after the partial)
policy_contracts.R1: NEW EXIT HYPOTHESIS: runner stop moves to entry (break-even) from the bar AFTER first-objective realization; BE counted FIRST within a bar (fail-closed); no spread adjustment (no authority)

controls.C0_1R: exit 100% at the frozen fixed 1R level; stop first; unresolved window => NULL
controls.C0_2R: exit 100% at the frozen fixed 2R level; stop first; unresolved window => NULL
controls.C0_3R: exit 100% at the frozen fixed 3R level; stop first; unresolved window => NULL
controls.C0_4R: exit 100% at the frozen fixed 4R level; stop first; unresolved window => NULL
controls.C0_5R: exit 100% at the frozen fixed 5R level; stop first; unresolved window => NULL

policy_contracts.fraction_rule: 3-point preregistered sensitivity grid; no percentage is promoted from DEV
policy_contracts.runner_rule: runner begins ONLY after the first objective is actually reached (no hypothetical credit); same-bar first+runner objective touch pays the runner objective (monotone path through the nearer level under the frozen stop-first scan)
policy_contracts.unresolved: no stop/target resolution inside the frozen 96-bar window => structural outcome NULL (UNRESOLVED/RUNNER_OPEN), never imputed, never a loss

populations.T1: research treatment; never assumed superior; never pooled for selection
